en.why_it_matters: This is one of the cleanest DMV genealogy dates on the calendar. Donald Byrd's Howard University experiment became one of the defining jazz-funk groups, and the current band still carries original members Keith Killgo and Joe Hall. In Baltimore, the point is less nostalgia than hearing the pocket, horn architecture and DC-rooted groove up close—the same musical DNA that later traveled far beyond jazz into hip-hop sampling and production culture.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for one of the two Baltimore sets, especially if groove and DMV music history are part of the thread. The band is actively touring and there are two chances that night, so the date is strong without needing rare-event scarcity.

en.why_it_matters: CPK is more interesting than a one-night all-star pickup: Coffin, Perlson and Krauss already have a recorded trio language, with no piano and a lot of harmonic responsibility pushed onto bass, reeds and rhythm. Lanzetti adds a guitarist whose Snarky Puppy vocabulary can thicken the groove without turning the room into generic fusion. At Keystone the attraction is the interaction, not the résumés.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for one of the two Baltimore sets if saxophone, bass-led harmony and modern fusion are in the thread. The same four musicians are touring together through other cities that week, so this is a strong short-trip date rather than a scarce event that should reorganize larger plans.

es.why_it_matters: Aquí no estamos frente a un rejunte de nombres para una sola noche: Coffin, Perlson y Krauss ya tienen un lenguaje de trío grabado, sin piano y con mucha responsabilidad armónica repartida entre bajo, sax y ritmo. Lanzetti mete una guitarra formada dentro del vocabulario de Snarky Puppy que puede engordar el groove sin volverlo fusión genérica. En Keystone lo importante va a ser la interacción, no los currículums.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio activamente a uno de los dos sets de Baltimore si el hilo va por sax, armonía guiada desde el bajo y fusión contemporánea. Los mismos cuatro músicos están girando juntos por otras ciudades esa semana, así que es una fecha fuerte de short trip, no una rareza que obligue a reconstruir planes mayores.
